title: fix_signal.skill.md: README preload causes oversized prompt requiring external Read tool
description: The fix_signal.skill.md prompt preloads the full .moeb/README.md which includes a complete specification index (>60KB). This causes the rendered output to exceed MCP token limits, forcing Claude Code to save it to a system temp file outside the project directory. The orchestrating agent must then use the external Read tool (not in the moeb registry) to read this file in chunks, causing automatic moeb-tool-origin rubric failures on every fix_signal invocation.
proposed_resolution: Remove or summarise the README.md specification index from the fix_signal prompt preload. Only harness policies, rubric criteria, and skill content are needed; the full 80+ specification listing is not required during fix_signal execution.
resolution_summary: Superseded by a1000063: consolidated prompt/README audit and MCP result overflow signal.
